name: MEDICINE STORAGE CABINET
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Controlled Room Temperature (CRT) Medicine Storage Cabinet is designed for medical and clinical trial applications where medicines are stored at 15°C and 25°C. Features double wall construction with stainless steel 304 interior, forced air circulation, and a microprocessor-based controller for uniform temperature distribution.
features: Uniform temperature distribution across the chamber via Axial Fan
Stainless steel 304 inner construction with corrosion-free exterior
Microprocessor based controller with audible/visual alerts
CFC free refrigeration system from reputed brands

specifications.Controller: Microprocessor based with Display of SV & PV
specifications.Air Circulation: Forced air circulation by Axial Fan
